verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations are a fair question for a communications SDK and API platform, but the evidence pack never documents batch APIs or multi-item operations. It covers only meeting media, messaging, PSTN and SIP features, and doc-format probes; per-meeting video limits and SIP routing to multiple locations are not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
